title: 1847 Magnolia Drive — Luxury Home Listing
subtitle: Austin, TX 78703 — Tarrytown Neighborhood

sections.title: Property Description
sections.content: Stunning modern farmhouse in the heart of Tarrytown with panoramic Hill Country views. Open-concept living with 12-foot ceilings, white oak hardwood floors throughout, and a chef's kitchen featuring Thermador appliances, quartzite countertops, and a 10-foot waterfall island. Primary suite on the main level with spa-inspired bathroom including a freestanding soaking tub and dual vanities. Three additional bedrooms upstairs with a flex space/game room. Covered back patio with outdoor kitchen, saltwater pool, and mature pecan trees providing natural shade.

sections.title: Recent Upgrades
sections.content: 2025 upgrades include: whole-home water filtration system ($8,500), Tesla Powerwall battery backup ($12,000), smart home integration with Control4 system ($15,000), and professional landscaping with native drought-resistant plants ($6,200). Total invested in improvements: $41,700.

sections.title: Neighborhood & Schools
sections.content: Tarrytown is one of Austin's most sought-after neighborhoods, located minutes from downtown, Lady Bird Lake, and Zilker Park. Walkability score: 82. Zoned for: Casis Elementary (10/10 GreatSchools), O. Henry Middle School (8/10), Austin High School (7/10). Average home prices in Tarrytown: $1.1M-$2.5M.

sections.title: Comparable Sales
sections.content: 2104 Pruett St: $1,190,000 (3,180 sq ft, sold 2/2026). 1923 Westover Rd: $1,340,000 (3,680 sq ft, sold 1/2026). 2015 Exposition Blvd: $1,225,000 (3,100 sq ft, sold 3/2026). Average comparable: $1,251,667. This listing is priced 1.9% above comparable average with superior upgrades.
